notes: Completes the Stream Desk interface across the dashboard, overview, tracker, library, game modes, settings, setup tools, popups, and installer, with responsive dark and light themes.
Adds Hot Potato and Mario Kaizo Challenge workflows with curated playlists, automatic next-hack selection, dashboard controls, and cumulative challenge exit tracking.
Adds guided RetroAchievements setup and exact-ROM trophy support for RetroArch, MiSTer, and FXPAK Pro.
Unifies advanced filters for title, creator, difficulty, type, release status, Hall of Fame, waiting moderation, and RetroAchievements throughout the app.
Moves slow catalog, downloader, tracker, and settings work off the interface path so pages open quickly and resize without flashing legacy colors.
Normalizes all RetroArch launches to prevent accidental fast-forward and FPS overlays.
Refreshes every shipped translation, setup window, warning, dialog, and installer page for the v2.0.0 interface.
Speeds up optional QUsb2Snes and RetroArch installation while preserving user tools and ROM libraries during uninstall.
Renames About & Updates to About and removes update checking from the information window.
Adds Updates as its own action under Settings > About & Updates.
Keeps both rows of About buttons visible at shorter window heights and swaps the Twitch and SMW Central button positions.
Prevents delayed outlined-button redraw callbacks from reporting Tkinter's "invalid command name" traceback after their popup has already closed.
Covers both already-destroyed buttons and the narrow timing race where a button disappears immediately after its existence check.
Adds one guided RetroAchievements setup button under Platform settings for RetroArch, MiSTer, and FXPAK Pro.

Configures RetroArch achievements automatically, installs MiSTer's native achievement configuration over the verified network connection, and installs and launches the official RA2Snes client for FXPAK Pro.
Keeps RetroAchievements passwords out of the tracker configuration and automatically reopens RA2Snes for future FXPAK Pro launches after setup.
Fixes the RetroAchievements setup button crash caused by a missing platform-name normalizer.
Installs MiSTer's official RetroAchievements Main and compatible cores from Set Up Now, safely backs up MiSTer.ini, and adds the RA launch section automatically.
Adds a crisp golden trophy beside every local Game Library ROM whose exact hash is supported by RetroAchievements.
Performs RetroAchievements catalog and ROM checks in the background, caches the results, and never uploads ROM data or local ROM hashes.
Prompts before launching a trophy-marked MiSTer game so the player can use the official RetroAchievements SNES core, the normal SNES core, or cancel.
Uses MiSTer's official RA_SNES launcher configuration and verifies that the achievement core is installed before starting it.
Prevents platform-only Settings saves from rebuilding the full interface and safely ignores widgets destroyed during an appearance refresh.
Adds Released, Hall of Fame, and RetroAchievements filters to the Game Library, game-mode pickers, Mario Kaizo playlists, random selection, Hack Gauntlet, and the SMW Central catalog browser.
Explains the gold RetroAchievements trophy and the yellow Hall of Fame and red waiting-review title colors directly in the Game Library.
Colors only special hack titles, leaving row backgrounds and the creator and difficulty columns unchanged.
Fixes oversized blank creator dropdowns in Curate Playlist and Play Random Hack while keeping the selected creator centered.
Gives Download & Patch Missing Hacks the Game Library status key, exact-ROM RetroAchievements trophies, yellow Hall of Fame titles, and red waiting-moderation titles without coloring entire rows.
